g.text: 100% In-Browser Image & PDF Creative Workspace • Zero Server Uploads • Client-Side WASM
Chitrax is a high-performance, privacy-first web workspace for creative image and PDF workflows. Engineered with Astro 7, React 19,
and Rust WebAssembly, all file processing runs 100% client-side in the browser. Zero server uploads, zero cloud tracking, zero latency.
Format Converter (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP)
Multi-Image to PDF & PDF to Image (ZIP)
PDF to Word Text Extraction Engine
Zero-Upload Privacy Architecture & Local Hardware Acceleration
Selected photos, scans, and PDFs never leave your browser. All AI matting, raster transformations, and cryptographic PDF operations
execute 100% client-side via Web Workers and Rust WebAssembly (crates/guided_filter). Live at chitrax.app.
